headlines.text: Looking back to 2026, when MJF vs. Kenny Omega fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynasty, rated 8.52 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. It marked MJF's 20th match with the title on the line. In a near 40-minute war involving two referees, a table, and nearly half a dozen V-Triggers, MJF used the Dynamite Diamond Ring to turn back Kenny Omega and retain the AEW World Title.

It was 2025 when Konosuke Takeshita vs. Brody King met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Collision, rated 8.17 ? an excellent showing. Takeshita, notably without Don Callis at ringside, overcame Brody King's chops with a deadlift wheelbarrow slam and running knee strikes to advance in the Owen Hart Cup.
Rewind to 2024, when it was Zak Knight's first night in AEW against Angelo Parker, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.62.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2023: Orange Cassidy vs. Buddy Matthews fought tooth and nail for the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.75 ? a solid showing.

Back on this day in 2026, a new champion was crowned for the AEW TNT Title as Kevin Knight vs. Anthony Bowens vs. Bandido vs. Daniel Garcia vs. El Clon vs. Mike Bailey vs. PAC vs. Rush vs. Tommaso Ciampa vs. Wheeler Yuta battled it out in a Casino Gauntlet match, appearing on Dynasty, rated 7.52 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle ? ending the champion's reign at 1 defense. It was the 130th time the AEW TNT Title had been on the line, a real piece of championship history. In a wild Casino Gauntlet for the vacant TNT Title at Dynasty, Kevin Knight outlasted a murderers' row that included Ciampa, Rush, Bandido, Bailey, El Clon, PAC, Garcia, Bowens and Yuta to walk out champion.

2026 brought us this moment: the AEW Continental Title was up for grabs as Jon Moxley vs. Will Ospreay went to war, appearing on Dynasty, rated 8.55 ? a stone-cold classic. Moxley survived a returning Will Ospreay's onslaught to retain the Continental Title, only for Ospreay to turn on the Death Riders afterward, still hunting revenge for the neck injury that had sidelined him.
